attributes.blockerTitle: Primitive fields cannot have Spec examples
attributes.detail:
`packages/base/spec.gts:115` states it outright — "Examples are not currently supported for primitive fields" — and the examples section is gated on `isPrimitive(this.cardDef)` at line 408. That blocks the example check for every primitive field spec: String, Number, Boolean, Date, DateTime, Markdown, Enum and Percentage (which extends NumberField). Eight of them are otherwise one check from Gold, with 2–26 real consumers each.

This is the same class of problem as the file defs: the standard asks for an artifact base will not let the author create. Either base gains primitive-field example support, or the standard exempts primitive fields and their denominator drops to 5. Deciding this is cheaper than either build.

cardInfo.name: Primitive fields cannot have Spec examples
cardInfo.summary: The 8 primitive-field specs cannot pass the example check at all
